title: Goose
oneLiner: Open-source AI agent from Block (now Linux Foundation) that automates engineering tasks via CLI and desktop app, with native MCP integration and any-LLM support.
summary: Goose is an open-source AI agent originally built by Block (Square) and now governed by the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation. It runs as a CLI, desktop app, and API on macOS, Linux, and Windows, supporting 15+ LLM providers and 70+ MCP extensions. Goose goes beyond code suggestions to install dependencies, run commands, execute tests, and edit files autonomously.
whyItMatters: Goose represents a major institutional commitment to open-source AI agents — backed by Block and now the Linux Foundation. Its MCP-first architecture, Rust-based performance, and multi-platform availability make it one of the most extensible and professionally maintained open-source coding agents.
bestFor: Developers who want a vendor-neutral, extensible AI agent with MCP support
Teams that prefer desktop app interfaces alongside CLI workflows
Engineers building custom agent workflows with composable MCP extensions
notFor: Users who need deep IDE integration over standalone desktop/CLI tooling
Teams looking for cloud-hosted managed agent services

coreStrengths.title: MCP-first architecture
coreStrengths.description: Goose was one of the earliest and deepest adopters of the Model Context Protocol, with 70+ documented extensions covering GitHub, Google Drive, databases, browsers, and custom APIs.
coreStrengths.whyItMatters: MCP-native design means Goose can connect to virtually any tool or service without waiting for vendor-specific integrations.

coreStrengths.title: Multi-LLM provider support
coreStrengths.description: Works with 15+ providers including Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Mistral, Ollama, OpenRouter, Azure, and Bedrock. Use API keys or existing subscriptions.
coreStrengths.whyItMatters: Vendor-neutral design means teams can switch models based on task, cost, or privacy requirements without changing workflows.

coreStrengths.title: Rust-based performance
coreStrengths.description: Core engine built in Rust for fast startup, low latency tool calls, and efficient resource usage.
coreStrengths.whyItMatters: Rust gives Goose a performance advantage over Node.js or Python-based agents, especially for long-running autonomous sessions.

coreStrengths.title: Desktop + CLI + API
coreStrengths.description: Available as a native desktop app, full CLI, and embeddable API — all from the same codebase.
coreStrengths.whyItMatters: Developers can choose the interface that fits their workflow, from GUI exploration to scripted automation.

seoArticle.intro: Goose represents a new model for open-source AI agent development: corporate backing with community governance. Originally built by Block (Square, Cash App) and now stewarded by the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation, Goose combines professional engineering with open-source transparency.
seoArticle.whatItIs: Goose is an open-source AI agent built in Rust that automates engineering tasks through a CLI, desktop app, and API. It supports 15+ LLM providers and 70+ MCP extensions for connecting to external tools and services.
seoArticle.whyItMatters: The Linux Foundation governance ensures Goose will remain open and community-driven long-term. Its MCP-first architecture sets a standard for extensibility, and its Rust-based engine delivers performance advantages over agent tools built in interpreted languages.
